declaration: Control plus two one-millimetre translations, declared before observing their per-position results. No replacement of failed cases with easier cases.
per_position_gates: isolated chained plan-only with no execution
scope_boundary: Small local translations only. No workspace-wide, arbitrary-yaw, moving-target, or hardware claim. Scene truth is excluded from the localization algorithm. Every prerequisite rejection and execution failure is retained.

motion_qualification.declaration: The 0.15 velocity trial is declared before execution, after software-rendering capture showed insufficient throughput for the unchanged 60 s observer wall bound. It requires a matching isolated plan and existing trajectory safety validation. Positions, collision rules, gripper profile and physics criteria remain unchanged.

planned_lift_region_qualification.declaration: Declared before execution: opt-in ros_sim-only workspace consistency during LIFT_EXEC. Initial observed center to initial center plus requested vertical lift (at most 40 mm), with unchanged 5 mm Euclidean segment-distance limit. Pre-lift static guard is unchanged. Axial lag, stationary objects and in-region drops are not grasp success; independent contact/lift/retention criteria remain mandatory.

measured_pad_qualification.declaration: Before execution: opt-in measured cube pose against fixed pad OBB with exact-source gripper TF, maximum 5 mm normalized SAT separation. Atomic target identity, center, orientation and source timestamp; pre-lift static guard unchanged. Geometric proximity is not physical contact or grasp success. 40-degree RGB-D mode passed offline and live tests.

yaw_adaptation_qualification.declaration: Preserve the declared X +/-1 mm cube positions and retain both original NO_IK_SOLUTION outcomes. Derive a small gripper yaw adjustment from the pinned shoulder pivot, pitch-axis normal, qualified baseline IK and measured RGB-D center, preserving the lateral planar-arm coordinate. No random search or replacement position. Each new candidate requires full static collision and chained plan-only validation before execution.
